map.输入工件长度、材料、切削速度与切深，计算刨削行程、往复次数与单件加工时间，辅助排: Enter the workpiece length, material, cutting speed, and depth of cut to compute the planer stroke, number of passes, and per-piece machining time for scheduling.
map.输入工件长度、材料、切削速度和切深，计算刨削行程、往复次数与加工时间: Enter the workpiece length, material, cutting speed, and depth of cut to compute the planer stroke, number of passes, and machining time
map.由行程长度、越程、切削速度估算单件切削时间。: Estimate the per-piece cutting time from stroke length, overtravel, and cutting speed.
map.批量生产排产与节拍核算。: Production scheduling and cycle-time accounting for batch manufacturing.
map.优化进给降低总工时。: Optimize the feed rate to cut total labor hours.
map.：工件长 L=200mm、越程 20mm、单刀往复 1 次：行程 H = 200: : Workpiece length L=200 mm, overtravel 20 mm, one single pass: stroke H = 200+2×20 = 240 mm; with vc=30 m/min, T = 240÷(30×1000) ≈ 0.008 min per stroke, and a batch of 100 pieces is scheduled from this.
map.：若 vc 提到 60m/min：T 减半，100 件总切削时间由约 0.8mi: : Raising vc to 60 m/min halves T, so the total cutting time for 100 pieces drops from about 0.8 min to 0.4 min, a clear cycle-time gain (excluding setup).
map.镗削（镗刀/镗杆/精度）控制: Boring (boring bar / boring bar holder / accuracy) control
map.刀具进出工件需安全距离防止啃刀与冲击，两端各加越程（一般 5–20mm），计入总: The cutter needs clearance entering and leaving the workpiece to prevent gouging and impact; add an overtravel of 5–20 mm at each end, and only count the total stroke for accurate results.
map.不含，仅纯切削行程时间；排产需叠加装夹、测量、换刀等辅助时间得单件总工时。: Not included — this is pure cutting stroke time; for scheduling you must add setup, measurement, tool change, and other auxiliary times to get the total per-piece labor hours.
